title: Exercise in Pregnancy — Safe, Recommended and Easy to Start

hook.en: Many pregnant women are told to "rest and not lift anything". In fact, regular exercise in an uncomplicated pregnancy is safe for mother and baby and lowers the risk of gestational diabetes, high blood pressure and excessive weight gain. Learn what to recommend, what to avoid and the warning signs that mean stop.
hook.ur: Bohat si hamila khawateen ko kaha jata hai "aaram karein aur kuch na uthayein". Asal mein be-paicheedgi hamal mein baqaida exercise maa aur bachay dono ke liye mehfooz hai aur hamal ki diabetes, hai blood pressure aur zyada wazan barhne ka khatra kam karti hai. Seekhein kya tajweez karein, kis se bachein aur kaun si alamaat rokne ka ishara hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll recommend the weekly exercise dose in pregnancy, choose safe activities for each trimester, screen for reasons not to exercise, and teach the warning signs that mean stop and seek care.
goal.ur: End tak aap hamal mein hafte ki exercise ki dosage tajweez karenge, har trimester ke liye mehfooz activities chunenge, exercise na karne ki wajah ki screening karenge, aur woh alamaat sikhayenge jin par ruk kar care leni chahiye.

text.en: For a woman with an **uncomplicated pregnancy**, guidelines recommend at least **150 minutes a week of moderate activity** (for example 30 minutes on 5 days), plus **pelvic floor exercises** daily and some strengthening. Women who were already active can usually continue their activity with changes; women who were inactive should **start gently and build up**. The aim is to stay healthy, not to set records. Exercise lowers the risk of **gestational diabetes and pre-eclampsia**, helps with back pain, mood and sleep, and does not increase the risk of miscarriage or early birth.
text.ur: **Be-paicheedgi hamal** wali khatoon ke liye guidelines hafte mein kam az kam **150 minute darmiyani activity** (maslan 5 din 30 minute), saath roz **pelvic floor exercises** aur kuch strengthening tajweez karti hain. Jo khawateen pehle se fa'aal theen woh aam taur par tabdeeli ke saath apni activity jaari rakh sakti hain; jo ghair fa'aal theen woh **narmi se shuru karein aur aahista barhayein**. Maqsad sehatmand rehna hai, record banana nahi. Exercise **hamal ki diabetes aur pre-eclampsia** ka khatra kam karti hai, kamar dard, mood aur neend mein madad deti hai, aur miscarriage ya waqt se pehle paidaish ka khatra nahi barhati.

text.en: Think of pregnancy as **driving a car with a precious passenger**: you still drive every day, you just choose smoother roads, keep a safe speed and pull over when a warning light comes on. Stopping the car completely is not the safest choice.
text.ur: Hamal ko **qeemti musafir ke saath gaari chalana** samjhein: aap ab bhi roz chalate hain, bas hamwaar sarakain chunte hain, mehfooz raftaar rakhte hain aur warning light jale to ruk jate hain. Gaari bilkul band kar dena sab se mehfooz faisla nahi.

title.en: Advising a pregnant woman on exercise
title.ur: Hamila khatoon ko exercise ka mashwara dena

steps.title: Screen for reasons not to exercise
steps.detail: Ask the obstetric team about complications: for example ruptured membranes, preterm labour, persistent bleeding, placenta praevia after 28 weeks, pre-eclampsia, significant heart or lung disease, or an incompetent cervix. || Exercise na karne ki wajah ki screening

steps.title: Set the dose
steps.detail: Aim for 150 minutes a week of moderate effort: she can talk but not sing. Brisk walking, a stationary bike, swimming and pregnancy classes are good choices. Add light strengthening 2 days a week. || Dosage tay karein

steps.title: Adapt as pregnancy progresses
steps.detail: Avoid lying flat on the back for long after about 16 to 20 weeks if she feels dizzy or unwell (side-lying or propped up instead); avoid contact sports, activities with a high risk of falling, scuba diving, and exercise in great heat. || Hamal barhne ke saath tabdeeli karein

steps.title: Teach the warning signs
steps.detail: Stop and seek care for vaginal bleeding, fluid leaking, regular painful contractions, chest pain, dizziness or fainting, headache with vision changes, calf pain or swelling, or reduced baby movements. || Warning signs sikhayein

question.en: How much exercise is recommended in an uncomplicated pregnancy?
question.ur: Be-paicheedgi hamal mein kitni exercise tajweez ki jati hai?

text.ur: Bilkul nahi — mukammal aaram sab se mehfooz hai

feedback.en: Rest is not safer and has its own risks.
feedback.ur: Aaram zyada mehfooz nahi aur is ke apne khatre hain.

text.en: Hard training to keep weight down
text.ur: Wazan kam rakhne ke liye sakht training

feedback.en: The goal is health, at a moderate effort.
feedback.ur: Maqsad sehat hai, darmiyani mehnat ke saath.

text.en: At least 150 minutes a week of moderate activity, plus daily pelvic floor exercises
text.ur: Hafte mein kam az kam 150 minute darmiyani activity, aur roz pelvic floor exercises

feedback.en: Yes — the same dose as for most adults, adapted for pregnancy.
feedback.ur: Haan — aksar baalighon wali dosage, hamal ke mutabiq tabdeel.

title.en: Good choices and ones to avoid
title.ur: Achhe intikhab aur jin se bachna hai

rows.en: Contact sports, high fall-risk activities, hot environments
rows.ur: Contact sports, girne ke zyada khatre wali activities, garam mahol

rows.en: Light weights, bands, squats to a chair
rows.ur: Halke wazan, bands, kursi tak squats

rows.en: Long periods flat on the back later in pregnancy if it makes her unwell
rows.ur: Hamal ke aakhri hisse mein der tak peeth ke bal agar bechaini ho

text.en: **Talk, cool, stop if signs.** Keep the effort at a talking pace, stay cool and hydrated, and stop for any warning sign.
text.ur: **Baat, thandak, alamat par ruk.** Mehnat baat karne ki raftaar par rakhein, thandi aur pani se bhari rahein, aur kisi bhi warning sign par ruk jayein.

text.en: **Telling every pregnant woman to stop exercising.** Without a medical reason, this removes real benefits and adds risks such as gestational diabetes and excess weight gain. Ask the obstetric team about complications, then encourage safe activity.
text.ur: **Har hamila khatoon ko exercise band karne ka kehna.** Kisi medical wajah ke baghair yeh asal faide khatam karta hai aur hamal ki diabetes aur zyada wazan jaise khatre barhata hai. Obstetric team se paicheedgiyon ka poochhein, phir mehfooz activity ki himmat dilayein.

question.en: Which of these is a reason not to exercise and to refer back to the obstetric team?
question.ur: In mein se kaun si exercise na karne aur obstetric team ko wapas bhejne ki wajah hai?

text.en: Mild low back pain at 24 weeks

feedback.ur: Exercise aksar is mein madad karti hai.

feedback.en: Adjust the dose; it is not a reason to stop.
feedback.ur: Dosage tabdeel karein; yeh rokne ki wajah nahi.

text.en: Persistent vaginal bleeding in the second trimester
text.ur: Doosre trimester mein musalsal vaginal bleeding

feedback.en: Yes — this needs medical assessment before any exercise.
feedback.ur: Haan — is ke liye kisi bhi exercise se pehle medical jaanch chahiye.

question.en: A runner at 28 weeks wants to keep running. What is the best advice?
question.ur: 28 hafte ki ek runner daurna jaari rakhna chahti hai. Behtareen mashwara kya hai?

text.en: She should increase her pace to stay fit
text.ur: Fit rehne ke liye raftaar barhaye

feedback.en: Pregnancy is not the time to push for gains.
feedback.ur: Hamal faida barhane ke liye zor lagane ka waqt nahi.

text.en: She must stop all running immediately
text.ur: Usay foran daurna band karna chahiye

text.en: She can usually continue at a comfortable, talking pace, reducing as needed and stopping for any warning sign
text.ur: Woh aam taur par aaramdeh, baat karne wali raftaar par jaari rakh sakti hai, zaroorat par kam kare aur kisi bhi warning sign par ruk jaye

feedback.en: Yes — active women can continue with sensible changes.
feedback.ur: Haan — fa'aal khawateen samajhdari ki tabdeeli ke saath jaari rakh sakti hain.

text.en: **Respect culture and modesty.** Many women prefer to exercise at home or with other women. Walking after meals, home exercise sheets, and classes run by female staff make it easier. Include the mother-in-law or husband in the advice when the woman wishes, as family support often decides whether she can be active.
text.ur: **Saqafat aur parde ka ehtiram karein.** Bohat si khawateen ghar par ya doosri khawateen ke saath exercise pasand karti hain. Khane ke baad chalna, ghar ki exercise sheets, aur khawateen staff ki classes isay aasan banati hain. Khatoon chahe to saas ya shohar ko mashware mein shamil karein, kyunke ghar ka saath aksar faisla karta hai ke woh fa'aal reh sakti hai ya nahi.

question.en: Why can lying flat on the back cause dizziness later in pregnancy?
question.ur: Hamal ke aakhri hisse mein peeth ke bal seedha letne se chakkar kyun aa sakta hai?

answer.en: The heavy uterus can press on the inferior vena cava, the large vein returning blood to the heart. Less blood returns, so blood pressure can drop, causing dizziness and nausea (supine hypotensive syndrome). Turning onto the left side relieves it at once.
answer.ur: Bhaari bachadani inferior vena cava par daba sakti hai, jo dil tak khoon wapas le jane wali bari rag hai. Kam khoon wapas aata hai, is liye blood pressure gir sakta hai, jis se chakkar aur matli hoti hai (supine hypotensive syndrome). Baayein karwat lene se foran aaram aa jata hai.

beats.patient: A 29-year-old teacher is 20 weeks pregnant with her first baby. She was inactive before pregnancy and has gained more weight than expected. Her obstetrician reports no complications. She worries exercise may harm the baby.
beats.assessment: She has no reason to avoid exercise and is at higher risk of gestational diabetes from inactivity and weight gain.
beats.treatment: Reassure her with the evidence; start 15 minutes of brisk walking daily after dinner, building to 30 minutes, add a pregnancy class twice a week and daily pelvic floor exercises, and teach the warning signs.
beats.reassess: She walks most evenings, her weight gain slows, and her glucose test at 28 weeks is normal.

text.en: **Stop and seek urgent care** for vaginal bleeding, fluid leaking from the vagina, regular painful contractions, chest pain, dizziness or fainting, severe headache or visual changes, calf pain or swelling, or reduced fetal movements. **Do not prescribe exercise without the obstetric team's advice** if there are complications such as placenta praevia after 28 weeks, preterm labour, ruptured membranes, pre-eclampsia or significant heart or lung disease.
text.ur: **Ruk kar fori care lein** vaginal bleeding, vagina se pani rasne, baqaida dardnak contractions, seene mein dard, chakkar ya behoshi, shadeed sar dard ya nazar ki tabdeeli, pindli mein dard ya sujan, ya bachay ki harkat kam hone par. **Obstetric team ke mashware ke baghair exercise na likhein** agar paicheedgiyan hon jaise 28 hafte ke baad placenta praevia, waqt se pehle dard-e-zeh, pani ki thaili ka phatna, pre-eclampsia ya dil ya phephron ki sangeen bimari.

summary.en: In an uncomplicated pregnancy, at least 150 minutes a week of moderate activity plus daily pelvic floor exercises is safe and recommended.
summary.ur: Be-paicheedgi hamal mein hafte mein kam az kam 150 minute darmiyani activity aur roz pelvic floor exercises mehfooz aur tajweez kardah hain.

summary.en: Choose walking, cycling, swimming and light strengthening; avoid contact sports, fall risks, heat and long periods flat on the back if they cause dizziness.
summary.ur: Chalna, cycling, tairaki aur halki strengthening chunein; contact sports, girne ke khatre, garmi aur chakkar aaye to der tak peeth ke bal letne se bachein.

summary.en: Screen with the obstetric team for complications and teach the warning signs that mean stop and seek care.
summary.ur: Obstetric team ke saath paicheedgiyon ki screening karein aur woh alamaat sikhayein jin par ruk kar care leni chahiye.

front.ur: Hamal mein hafte ki exercise ki dosage?

back.en: At least 150 minutes of moderate activity, plus pelvic floor exercises.
back.ur: Kam az kam 150 minute darmiyani activity, aur pelvic floor exercises.

front.en: Why avoid lying flat for long late in pregnancy?
front.ur: Hamal ke aakhir mein der tak seedha letne se kyun bachein?

back.en: The uterus can compress the vena cava and drop blood pressure (dizziness).
back.ur: Bachadani vena cava ko daba kar blood pressure gira sakti hai (chakkar).

front.en: Name three warning signs to stop exercise.
front.ur: Exercise rokne ki teen warning signs batayein.

back.en: Vaginal bleeding, regular painful contractions, chest pain (also fluid leak, dizziness, calf swelling).
back.ur: Vaginal bleeding, baqaida dardnak contractions, seene mein dard (aur pani rasna, chakkar, pindli ki sujan).
